pages.title: DeskVNC: an AI agent that can drive your remote desktops
pages.description: DeskVNC is one native client for VNC, RDP and SSH on Windows, macOS and Linux. Its dvv MCP server lets an AI agent open a saved machine, read the screen and send clicks and keystrokes over the protocol, with nothing installed on the target.
